title: Move the loyalty program to BON Loyalty
summary: Rebuild the program's rules in BON, export customer points from the old app, let appspend turn them into BON's points file, have BON's team load it, spot-check balances, then switch the storefront and cancel the old app.

yotpo_loyalty.name: Yotpo Loyalty
yotpo_loyalty.export: In Yotpo Loyalty, go to Customers and click Export all. If you use VIP tiers, note each tier's name and threshold too.

loyaltylion.name: LoyaltyLion
loyaltylion.export: In LoyaltyLion, go to Analytics > Exports and export Customers. It includes approved, pending and spent points plus tier. Export Tiers and Referrals as well if you use them.

smile.name: Smile.io
smile.export: In Smile, go to Customers and export all customers as CSV. Export VIP and referral activity separately if you use them.

all: BON's import file holds points only: VIP tier status must be rebuilt in BON (send BON the tier export and ask them to match it).
Referral links from the old program stop working; BON issues new ones.
Points history (what was earned when) doesn't carry over, only current balances.
Customers with zero points aren't in the file; they join BON with nothing, as before.
loyaltylion: Pending points (not yet approved) are left out. Approve or expire them before exporting.

mapping.note: must exist in Shopify customers; BON syncs from Shopify
filled from the Shopify customers export when the loyalty export lacks it

hello.to: BON Loyalty support (live chat in the BON app)
hello.subject: Migrating {store} from {from_name}
hello.body:
Hi BON team,

We're moving {store} from {from_name} to BON. We have {r[build][customers]:,} customers holding {r[build][points]:,} points, and we'll send the points file in your 3-column format. If we use VIP tiers, we'll send that export too so the tiers match. Can you import it and tell us when it's done?

Thanks

rollback: Until the old app is cancelled, its program keeps running. If BON's balances look wrong, keep the old widget live and ask BON to redo the import.

steps.title: Agree the plan: {from_name} to BON
steps.instructions: Show the merchant what moves and what doesn't. BON's team imports points for free, and the old program keeps running until the switch.

steps.title: Install BON and rebuild the program
steps.instructions: Install BON Loyalty from https://apps.shopify.com/bon-loyalty-rewards. Set earning rules, rewards and point values to match {from_name} exactly, so balances mean the same thing. Set up VIP tiers if you have them. Keep BON's widgets off for now.

steps.title: Export customers and points from {from_name}
steps.instructions: {v[export]} Also export customers from Shopify admin (Customers > Export, all customers, CSV) so appspend can fill in Shopify customer IDs.

inputs.name: shopify_customers_file
inputs.label: Path to the Shopify customers export

steps.title: Build BON's points file
steps.instructions: appspend turns the export into BON's 3-column file (Shopify customer ID, email, points), leaves out zero balances, and picks 5 customers for a spot check after the import.

inputs.name: shopify_customers_file
inputs.label: Path to the Shopify customers export

steps.title: Approve the points cut-off
steps.instructions: Points earned in {from_name} after the export won't reach BON. Either re-export right before sending the file, or tell customers balances pause for a day.

steps.title: Send the points file to BON
steps.instructions: In BON, go to Customer Data > Import data and select {from_name} as the source app. Then send {workdir}/bon-points-import.csv through BON's live chat with this message. BON's team loads points by hand.

steps.title: Spot-check five balances
steps.instructions: Look up these customers in BON and compare their points with the file: {r[build][spot_check_text]}. All five must match. Check the total customer count in BON too ({r[build][customers]} expected).

steps.title: Approve the switch to BON
steps.instructions: Switching shows BON's widget and emails to customers and turns {from_name} off. Customers see new referral links. Consider a short email announcing the new program.

steps.title: Switch the storefront to BON
steps.instructions: Turn on BON's widget, account page and checkout points display. Turn off {from_name}'s embed and blocks in the theme editor, and stop its emails (including any loyalty flows in your email tool).

steps.title: Cancel {from_name}
steps.instructions: Uninstall {from_name} in Shopify admin > Settings > Apps, and cancel any direct contract in writing. Keep the export file: it's your record of balances on the switch date.
